task: steady reconstruction of a frozen turbulent snapshot from synthetic projected trajectories
scientific_scope: Spatial blocked holdout within one DNS t=1 snapshot; not independent DNS realizations, time forecasting, or measured time-dependent particle tracking.

split.training_group_key: macroblock_id; preserve original flow_group_id and parent simulation identity separately

trajectory_generation.particle_selection: Uniform seeded initial positions, no path-length ranking; fixed disjoint 32 probes; all N from common observation permutation.
trajectory_generation.horizon_rule: 0.75 * 4 * native_spacing / maximum training-case speed_max. Fixed global horizon from TRAIN only; test not consulted.
trajectory_generation.preflight: Numerically check displacements, exits and RK4 convergence on training cases; retain masks on heldout exits. This candidate horizon is not yet advection-validated.
trajectory_generation.training_particle_selection: Reserve fixed32probes; on training epochs use a common seeded permutation of remaining pool, with nested N prefixes. Freeze validation/test selections.
